basic_details.job_title: MATI Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 16 Peon, Sweeper and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: Meghalaya Administrative Training Institute (MATI), Shillong, has invited applications for 16 posts in 4 roles under Advt No. MATI.7/2015/Vol.II/241-A. The posts include Peon, Cleaner, Sweeper, Chowkidar. The online application is open from 1 December 2026 to 31 December 2026.

how_to_apply: Apply online only through https://rpa.meghalaya.gov.in/rpaonline/; applications by any other mode will be summarily rejected.
First-time online applicants must complete a one-time registration.
Read the instructions on the web page before applying.
Pay the non-refundable examination fee for each post by e-Challan (cash at any SBI branch) or debit/ATM/credit card or net banking.
Choose the examination centre carefully; change of centre will not be entertained.
Complete registration and application by 17.00 hours on 31 December 2026.
important_instructions: No Ineligibility List will be published; candidature of anyone found not qualified at any stage will be cancelled Requests to change category after applying will not be entertained Admission to all stages is provisional, subject to eligibility False information or unfair means can lead to debarment from examinations of the Institute Reservation as per the Roster Reservation Policy of the Government of Meghalaya For problems with the online application, contact the MATI office in person or e-mail [email protected] with phone number

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for MATI Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Apply online only through https://rpa.meghalaya.gov.in/rpaonline/; applications by any other mode will be summarily rejected. First-time online applicants must complete a one-time registration. Read the instructions on the web page before applying. Pay the non-refundable examination fee for each post by e-Challan (cash at any SBI branch) or debit/ATM/credit card or net banking. Choose the examination centre carefully; change of centre will not be entertained. Complete registration and application by 17.00 hours on 31 December 2026.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for MATI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 31 December 2026. Applications opened on 1 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in MATI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 16 vacancies: 5 Peon, 5 Cleaner, 5 Sweeper, 1 Chowkidar.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for MATI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 31 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: General: Rs. 100 per post. SC/ST (permanent residents of Meghalaya): Rs. 50 per post.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is should have attained the age of 18 years and not more than 32 years (as on 1 January 2026). Relaxation: SC/ST 5 years, Meghalaya Government employees No age limit, provided they entered service within the prescribed age limit.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: L-1 of Revised Pay Structure for Peon, L-1 of Revised Pay Structure for Cleaner, L-1 of Revised Pay Structure for Sweeper, L-1 of Revised Pay Structure for Chowkidar.

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Class III Passed or Lower Primary Examination or equivalent (all posts). The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Applicants must be Citizens of India (as defined in Article 5 - 8 of the Constitution). Date of birth accepted only as in Matriculation/Secondary School Leaving Certificate or other certificates listed in the notice. PH candidates must possess a Disability certificate issued by competent Authority.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Screening Test (MCQ): General English; General Knowledge & Current Affairs. Screening Test in MCQ pattern on General English. All applicants will be called for the Screening Test / Written Examination irrespective of whether they are qualified. Examination centres: Shillong, Tura and Jowai.

faq.answer: Meghalaya Administrative Training Institute, Mawdiangdiang, Shillong.
